description:
Get data for a budget view, including its `columns` array. Each column's `attribute` is the key used for that column's value in every row returned by the Detail Rows and Summary Rows v2.0 endpoints for this budget view.
Pass `source_snapshot_id` to read the budget view as of a snapshot instead of live. Only the contents of `columns` change between live and snapshot responses — the response shape is otherwise identical.

parameters.name: budget_view_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Budget View (also known as Budget Template).

parameters.name: source_snapshot_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for a budget snapshot.
If provided, the response reflects that snapshot instead of the live budget.
If omitted, the response reflects the live budget.

This single query parameter...

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project. Must be provided to return a snapshot's budget view.

id.description: Unique identifier for the budget view. Use as the {budget_view_id} path parameter in budget view requests.

role.description: Role of the budget view, indicating whether it is used for budgeting or forecasting.

created_by.description: Name of the user who created the budget view, formatted for the company. Null if the creator cannot be resolved.

assignment_level.description: Level at which the budget view is assigned. `company` applies to all projects, `project` to a specific set, and the `*_integrated_projects` values scope the assignment to ERP-integrated or non-ERP-...

assigned_projects_count.description: Number of projects assigned to this budget view. Returns 0 when the assignment level is not `project`.

total_projects_count.description: Total number of projects available in the company.

date_created.description: Formatted date and time when the budget view was created, localized to the company's timezone.

columns.description: Columns included in the budget view, in display order. Present only on the show response.

items.description: Visible columns for a budget view

groupings.description: Row groupings applied to the budget view, ordered from outermost to innermost tier. Present only when the view is resolved in a project context.
